[Apache Http Server](https://httpd.apache.org/) is a web server developed by the [Apache Software Foundation](https://www.apache.org/).

## Enabling

To enable the Apache HTTP server service on your system, add the following options to your <a href="NixOS_system_configuration" class="wikilink" title="NixOS system configuration">NixOS system configuration</a>. Additionally, you may wish to open the appropriate ports in the <a href="firewall" class="wikilink" title="firewall">firewall</a> to allow HTTP and HTTPS traffic.

Refer to for more module configuration options.
